title: Vis Spec
description: High-level specification of the visualizations and analytics required. Produced by the visualization agent. Each item is tagged `execution`: `in_situ` items (solution output, in-situ rendering) are implemented by code-generation inside the simulation binary; `post_hoc` items are implemented and run by the visualization agent as standalone post-processors.

problem_spec_id.description: Omitted for programming-lane tasks, which produce no problem spec.

numerical_plan_id.description: Omitted for programming-lane tasks, which skip numerical analysis and have no numerical plan to reference.

params.description: Isovalues, camera, transfer function, colormap, range, etc.

execution.description: in_situ = implemented by code-generation inside the binary; post_hoc = implemented and run by the visualization agent.

auxiliary_computations.description: Extra computations the simulation/viz code must perform, e.g. particle tracing.

analytics.description: Quantitative, FACTUAL diagnostics the code should emit; interpretation happens downstream.

execution.description: in_situ = emitted by the simulation binary (code-generation); post_hoc = computed by the visualization agent from output files.
